notes.note: Merge of origin/main 3b001e5e5 into #2933: this record conflicted on the app-home.ts binding, so main's record was taken and the document re-read against both changes. Main (#3032) adds GET /agent/:id/device-code-profiles in app-home.ts, a scoped read of refs, labels, auth state and device-code support for an explicitly granted device. This branch (#2933) changes approval handling in claude-adapter.ts, acp-adapter.ts and pre-tool-policy.ts: autoApprove answers plain calls only, an autoApprove match is no PreToolUse allow, ACP plan exits and questions get no standing answer, and a denyApprovals child is denied at once. Main's edit to this page (display label; the dedicated engine sign-in read exposes only refs, labels, auth state and observed device-code support) matches the merged route. The page makes no claim about tool approval, so this branch's changes leave it accurate. No further prose change.
